# Rxova React Inputs

> Nine headless, accessible React input components — locale-aware currency,
> fractional ratings, one-time codes, passwords, international phone numbers,
> segmented date and time fields, tags and files — each published as its own npm
> package, plus a meta-package that installs the suite. Platform semantics and
> native form submission throughout: a real `<input>` does the work, so paste,
> autofill, IME, undo and screen-reader behaviour come from the browser rather
> than from JavaScript. Zero runtime dependencies each. No stylesheet to import.
> React >= 18. MIT.

This file is the map, not the manual. It exists because an agent that reaches
this project through the repository tree — rather than through an install or the
docs site — lands on `AGENTS.md`, which is written for someone editing the suite
and answers almost nothing about using it.

Deliberately pointer-only. Every fact about a component's API belongs to exactly
one file, and that file is checked against `src/types.ts`; restating any of it
here would create a second copy that nothing verifies and that goes stale on the
first renamed prop.

## Packages

Each ships its `llms.txt` inside its npm tarball, so after an install it is
readable straight out of `node_modules` with no network — the props table, a
working example, and what the component deliberately does not do. That is the
file to read when you are writing calling code.

- [@rxova/react-inputs](packages/react-inputs/llms.txt): the whole suite from one
  install, tree-shaken to what you import. Equivalent to the individual packages.
- [@rxova/react-intl-currency-input](packages/react-intl-currency-input/llms.txt):
  money entry with correct grouping and symbols, and no cursor bugs.
- [@rxova/react-rating-input](packages/react-rating-input/llms.txt): any icon, any
  precision, with `radiogroup` semantics and a read-only image mode.
- [@rxova/react-otp-input](packages/react-otp-input/llms.txt): one-time codes with
  spatial slots, paste handling and WebOTP autofill.
- [@rxova/react-password-input](packages/react-password-input/llms.txt): reveal
  toggle, Caps Lock warning, and a strength meter that costs 1 kB.
- [@rxova/react-phone-input](packages/react-phone-input/llms.txt): international
  numbers with no metadata blob — E.164 in and out.
- [@rxova/react-date-input](packages/react-date-input/llms.txt): segmented,
  locale-ordered date entry with no calendar and no date library.
- [@rxova/react-time-input](packages/react-time-input/llms.txt): segmented time
  entry, 12/24-hour by locale, canonical 24-hour value.
- [@rxova/react-tags-input](packages/react-tags-input/llms.txt): tags and tokens
  with a real roving tab order and announced add/remove.
- [@rxova/react-file-input](packages/react-file-input/llms.txt): picker and drop
  zone with accept/size rules, dedupe and managed previews.
- [@rxova/codemod](packages/codemod/llms.txt): jscodeshift transforms for the
  supported migration paths. The executable path off another library — prefer it
  over rewriting call sites by hand.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://rxova.org/packages/react-inputs/): every page also
  exists as raw markdown — add `.md` to any URL.
- [llms.txt](https://rxova.org/packages/react-inputs/llms.txt): the docs index.
- [llms-full.txt](https://rxova.org/packages/react-inputs/llms-full.txt): every
  page inlined, when one fetch should be the whole thing.
- [Overview](https://rxova.org/packages/react-inputs/overview.md): what this suite
  is for, and where it is the wrong answer.
- [shadcn registry](https://rxova.org/packages/react-inputs/r/registry.json): the
  components as `npx shadcn@latest add` items.
